samples.summary: Header/footer slim toolbar toggles still have no `pressed` binding, so button state doesn't follow the range the action now uses
samples.evidence: The slim B/I/U `<Toggle>`s at lines 449, 458 and 467 render with only `onPressedChange` — no `pressed` prop — so they are uncontrolled and flip their own highlight independent of the document. The PR routes their *action* through `getRangeStyleSummary()` but leaves state unwired, so the slim toolbar's B button can show pressed while the range is unstyled (and vice versa) — the mirror-image of the state/action divergence the change fixes in `TextFormatGroup` (which updated both). Pre-existing, but this change is exactly where the state wiring would land.

finding.summary: Keyboard shortcut path still reproduces #715 — only the toolbar was fixed
finding.evidence: `TextEditor.toggleStyle` (invoked from Cmd/Ctrl+B / I / U / Shift+X at text-editor.ts:872-890) still decides add-vs-remove from `getStyleAtCursor()`, the exact caret sampling the issue identifies as wrong for backward selections. After this change, backward-selecting `cd` inside a bold run and pressing Cmd+B remains a permanent no-op, while clicking the toolbar B works — the same document now behaves differently through two entry points. The task file (docs/tasks/active/20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:52-56) declares this out of scope and says it is 'Recorded as a known limitation', but no design doc under docs/design/ records it; the limitation lives only in a task file that gets archived. If the issue's outcome is 'the Bold toggle works on backward selections', the keyboard half is unmet.

verdict.reason: Every factual element of the finding checks out. text-editor.ts:869-892 binds Cmd/Ctrl+B/I/U/Shift+X to `toggleStyle`, and `toggleStyle` at text-editor.ts:2884 still derives add-vs-remove from `getStyleAtCursor()` (defined 2967-2981 using the `offset <= inlineEnd` caret walk that the task file at 20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:15-18 names as the root cause of #715), then applies the inverted value to the whole selection range at 2914. `getRangeStyleSummary` was introduced only on the toolbar side (frontend text-format-group.tsx, style-summary.ts, docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx) and appears nowhere in packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts, so the toolbar and keyboard entry points now behave differently on the same backward selection. No guard makes the shortcut unreachable: the only window-level docs key handlers are Cmd+Alt+M (docs-view.tsx:514-529) and Cmd+/ (docs-view.tsx:536-546), neither touching B/I/U. The task file at lines 50-56 does declare the keyboard path out of scope as a "known limitation", and a grep of docs/design/docs/ for getStyleAtCursor / range-aware / backward found no design doc recording it, so the limitation indeed lives only in an active task file that will be archived. Refutation grounds considered and rejected: not-present (code is exactly as described), already-guarded (no guard), out-of-scope (an incomplete fix leaving divergent behavior across two entry points plus an undocumented residual limitation is spec-conformance/design-doc discipline, this lens's lane). The issue #715 body was not provided, so I cannot rule out that its acceptance criteria covered only the toolbar; that uncertainty keeps the finding per instructions.
